integrity_notes: Proof uses direct transfer invariance, Tonelli, binary inducing, and established conservative-ergodic uniqueness. Exact finite checks support but do not certify infinite claims; general inducing theory may potentially subsume an explicit specialization.
limitations: Exact arbitrary-countable iid parameter law for the stated dyadic interval family, within the class of Lebesgue-equivalent invariant measures. Does not cover singular stationary measures, observation noise, or finite-data identification.
title: Exact stationary-density tomography and renewal clocks for low-slope random interval maps
